authority.method: certified dyadic interval greedy replay plus exact target binary digits, selected-divisor convolution, and strict-record divisor genealogy

finite_shift_control.conclusion: GP4 is not a generic support-word or divisor-genealogy tautology: adding the single forced coin at rank three leaves the tail support identical but creates exact GP4 failures.  A proof for 1/21 must use its exact source bits.

nonclaims: The target panel is finite and not a census of all rationals.
The control does not prove GP4 for 1/21 at all depths.
The control does not prove WGP4 for any target at all depths.
The control does not prove normalized weak-parent monotonicity.
The control does not decide Erdos Problem 257.

panel_summary.interpretation: The panel is a falsification control, not evidence for a universal rational-target genealogy theorem.
panel_summary.normalized_weak_parent_interpretation: Nine targets satisfy defect-density monotonicity on every tested weak-parent edge.  Target 1/5 has one finite-seed failure at rank 29 and no later failure in the checked range.
